title: Cohomology commutes with direct sums of modules on a qcqs scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $(\mathcal F_i)_{i\in I}$ be any family of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $p\ge0$. The canonical $\mathcal O_X(X)$-linear map $\bigoplus_{i\in I}H^p(X,\mathcal F_i)\to H^p(X,\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i)$ induced by the inclusions of the summands is an isomorphism [pqf-def-cohomology]. In particular this holds for the family indexed by the nonnegative graded pieces of a quasi-coherent graded module.
